name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.1-beta+11

- Fix blank For you rows; smoother scrolling
  - For you (Home and Movies & TV): cards get the normal card height, so they draw instead of leaving a blank space
  - Card animation plays once, when a row first shows, not every time a row or card comes back on screen
  - Nearby rows stay built on Home and Movies & TV; Movies & TV rows are kept when scrolled away instead of reloading
  - Movies & TV rows load small posters (details page keeps the large one)
